credit.title: siren fire truck north american distant drive by one block over echo +tree wind hiss
credit.author: kyles

species: A real North American fire truck sounding its air horn, 'honk-honk-honk', as it drives by a block away
note: Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording (Sony PCM-D50). The 70 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency traffic rumble.
